# function: is_fqdn

True when the name ends in a dot. The empty string is false: it is not a name at all, let alone a qualified one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# True when the name already ends in a dot. The empty string is false: it is
# not a name at all.
output "already_qualified" {
  value = provider::powerdns::is_fqdn("example.com.") # true
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
is_fqdn(name string) bool
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `name` (String) The name to test.
